principle: Consistency and construct stability may nominate a development milestone; they must not silently rewrite the athlete's declared level.
allowed_output_before_calibration: Your movement consistency is building toward the next development band; keep collecting comparable sessions.
forbidden_outputs: promotion based on immediate post-drill performance
activation_rule: Enable nomination only after the cohort registry contains a validated cohort for the athlete's age/context and retention/transfer fields are populated.
